__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’)
__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’ · also neut. acc. sg. governed by ἐς: ’into evil’ (ἐς κακὸν … βάλῃσθα) · also neut. acc. sg. subject of an infinitive: ’an evil’ (κακὸν ἔμμεναι ’that an evil is’)
__broaden__.κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg.: ’a bad thing, evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’) · also neut. nom. sg. adjective agreeing with πέλωρ: ’evil’ (πέλωρ κακόν ’an evil monster’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun, predicate: ’an evil’ (ἀθάνατον κακόν ’an immortal evil’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun with a comparative, predicate: ’a greater evil’ (μεῖζον … κακόν)
__broaden__.παρὲξ: παρέξ — beside, past, beyond; adv./prep. + acc., here adverbial with εἴποιμι: ’say otherwise, speak beside the point’ · also adv. with ἐλάσωσιν, ’past, beyond’ (τάς γε παρὲξ ἐλάσωσιν ’drive past them’) · also prep. + acc.: ’past, beyond’ (παρὲξ τὴν νῆσον ἐλαύνετε ’drive past the island’)
__broaden__.σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., masc. acc. pl., epic σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by διά: ’through them’ · also acc. pl. object of a verb of teaching: ’them’ (σφέας … ἐδίδαξε ’taught them’) · also acc. pl. reflexive object, with αὐτούς: ’themselves’ (πυκάζοιεν σφέας αὐτούς)
__broaden__.τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: masc./neut. dat. pl. ’in which, with which’ (τετυγμένα, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν ’well-made, in which he milked’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: ’the’ (ἰχθύσι τοῖς ὀλίγοισι ’for the little fishes’)
__broaden__.τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., acc. sg. (agreeing with ἄεθλον) · also acc. sg. agreeing with ὄλεθρον: ’this destruction’
__broaden__.ἐρετμά: ἐρετμόν — oar; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb: ’the oars’ (ἔπτατ’ ἐρετμά ’the oars flew’)
__broaden__.ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’ · also in ὡς ὅτ’, ’as when (a minstrel does)’, the verb left unexpressed · also in ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ introducing a simile with a finite verb expressed: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ … ἁλιεὺς … προΐησι)
__broaden__.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’)
__broaden__.πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
__broaden__.κάλλιμον: κάλλιμος — beautiful, fair (= Attic καλός); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα · also fem. acc. sg. (two-ending adjective), agreeing with ὄπα: ’fair’ (ὄπα κάλλιμον ’a fair voice’)
__broaden__.πίεζον: πιέζω — press, squeeze; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίεζον): ’I pressed’ · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they pressed’ (πλείοσί μ’ ἐν δεσμοῖσι … πίεζον ’they pressed me in more bonds’)
__broaden__.ἠεροειδέα: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, dark like mist; masc. acc. sg. · also fem. acc. sg. (two-ending adjective), agreeing with πέτρην: ’misty-looking’
